entities.summary: Anna Maiques Dern is a former field hockey player from Spain. She was a member of the Women's National Team that won the golden medal at the 1992 Summer Olympics on home soil (Barcelona). Anna Maiques was a athletes & competitors from Terrassa (b. 1967-09-03, Terrassa). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
